updates.title: VAICOM Community Edition for DCS World
updates.releasenotes:
BETA 3.1.3.11 
- OpenKneeboard OUt now groups keywords in row across format to keep similar comands at the top of the window. 
- OpenKneeboard OUT F-4E keywords now have phase of flight handlingbased on last sent command. 
- OpenKneeboard OUT pages refresh on any passed command without requirening the Page Command. 
- Add WSO commands for fuel managment, tanker or airfield divert also add display support. 
- Add WSO commands Radar Lock Target, and Radar Focus target [1-20] to Openkeeboard commands list. 
- Add Plugin controls for OpenKneeboard OUT tab browsing for use in Voice Attack 'execute an external plugin command'. 
- Fix bug in last build with recipient aliases. 
- Adds WSO Vaicom custom Mod demo 'Start Shutdown' Boots will start switching off the back cockpit and advise you to continue when he's completed the shutdown. 
- Add check for on ground for WSO Shutdown command and fix Radar mode handling, also turn off INS. 
- Add WSO Alitude Monitor set an altitude and Boots will give you a callout if you descend 20ft RA below it. 
- Add vaicom mods section to jester Wheel under Crew Contract. 
- Changes to WSO Shutdown Custom Command timings and functions. 
- Fix F-14 AIRO file swapping and enable check box Jester Enable. 
- Fix AIRIO commands incorrectly requires recipient on ICS Hot Mic. 
- VAICOM F-4E WSO vap gets refreshed on every startup. 
- OKB OUT now has ability to accept new port if user desires. (Must restart OpenKneeboard to see effect) 
- Fix Jester 2.0 Mod Shutdown and add aditional items to fully secure cockpit 
- Minor graphicks change to OKB Port dialog 
- Fix TACAN not showing in kneeboards on servers with late spawned tankers.
- Fix Hold AI transmission not checked stopped AI response being heard. 
- OpenKneeboard OUT New keywords groups and Phases. 
- Openkneeboard OUT Voice commands AI CREW Page to browse to AI Crew Tab. 
- OpenKneeboard OUT Night Mode option for those lonely cocpit nights.
- Fix TX1-4 gate timing for some users. 
- Add WSO plugin context capability for Jester 2.0 Mods. 
- F10 menu send empty if menu too large.
- Add FLT PLN Out an additioanl flight plan and SA tool for OKB OUT
